notes.title: Playtest #2
notes.content: Yo Playtesters,I want to cordially invite you all to come and join us this Saturday 9/6/2025 from 5pm-8pm PDT for our 2nd playtest.  Oh, and don't forget to clip your plays, they're a ton of fun to watch as they really showcase the gameplay.  You can post them in our Discord or Subreddit  to share with the community (links on our store page).  Maybe we'll vote to see which is the best one.  You can also post bugs (hopefully there are none) there too.I'll see you in net...bring it,Harper

notes.title: PLAYTEST - Today, Tomorrow & Saturday! EXTENDED to Sunday
notes.content:
YO, you ready to go COAST TO COAST?  We are!

UPDATE: Extended to Sunday, starting now - ending TBD.  Join the Discord for more details.


After the anticipated one week wait, we are scheduling 3 playtest times. One today (7/31), one tomorrow and one on Saturday starting at 1:30pm PDT and ending at 4pm PDT.  The first 30 minutes are reserved for our playtest team (THAT'S YOU) to download and PRACTICE (Goalie is one of the goated positions) the Hockey Club Playtest which will show up in your Library as a separate game.  The DOWNLOAD LINK (you may need to logout/log back into steam) is found on our STORE PAGE where you first signed up to playtest:


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45685051/7d9bb1784f9159e8b83622a293b87d53e995c739.png"]



GAME MATCH UPs will begin at 2pm PST and continue until 4pm PST, for each of these days.  The Hockey Club Playtest is found in your LIBRARY after download:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45685051/877cf85c935ed8eec029855def782d72fc416ce6.png"]

Remember when we mentioned some of our Beta Test gamers were better than us?  WELL, NOT ANYMORE...we are kind of sweaty at our game...if you sell the match, YOU'RE BANNED! ːsteamsaltyː



Lastly, we are also working on a notification system for letting our Playtest Team know when these Playtests will be made available.  Details on that are coming...  Oh, and to our Friends in other Countries (non-USA), bear with us, we will figure something to help you out! 



'til then...SEE YOU ON THE ICE,



Harper

notes.title: Pre-launch/Closed Beta Test Patch - v0.0.1
notes.content:
Hey All,



We added a single player practice rink with a Help Menu, where you can test your builds per position.  This was well received by our beta test team!  Because of the complexity of the controls, our team welcomed this mode in order to become familiar with all the functionality under-the-hood.  Initially, some of our more seasoned "giga-gamers," we introduced to Hockey Club, were a bit daunted by the functionality, but after 8 hours of explaining things, they started playing better than us!  WHAT!!!!



I guess WE need to put in more practice...can't wait.



Anyway, we'll call this patch 0.0.1, in order to create a start and keep track of our progress to launch.



Check back often and I'll keep you all posted...thanks and take care,



Jason ("Harper")

Developer (1 of 3) of Hockey Club
